notes.GONDA: Gonda (Goldschmied) Neuroscience and Genetics Research Center is OSM's misspelled "Gonda (Goldschmeid) Center" (alt_name Gonda Building), not the Neuroscience Research Building next door.
notes.edwin-w-pauley-pavilion: Varsity arena, not a student gym.
notes.southern-regional-library-facility: Off-site storage library; students don't study there.
notes.mullin-management-commons: Part of the Anderson School of Management, not a dining hall.
notes.weyburn-commons: Graduate housing community building, not a dining hall.
notes.saxon-commons: Saxon Suites community building; OSM shows no dining there.
notes.mo-ostin-basketball-center: Varsity basketball practice centre, not a student gym.
notes.de-neve-plaza: Centre of the Acacia, Birch, Cedar, Dogwood and Evergreen Residential Buildings (the Plaza's low-rises; OSM has no Fir).
